description: Computer Architecture & Networking — Digital logic to distributed consensus

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Boolean Algebra and Logic Gates
topics.prompt: lets talk about boolean algebra, logic gates AND OR NOT NAND NOR XOR XNOR, truth tables, De Morgan's theorems, and how gates are physically implemented with transistors

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Combinational Circuits
topics.prompt: combinational circuits, multiplexers, demultiplexers, encoders, decoders, full adder, ripple carry adder, carry lookahead adder, and how ALU is built from these components

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Sequential Circuits
topics.prompt: sequential circuits, SR latch, D flip-flop, JK flip-flop, T flip-flop, registers, shift registers, counters synchronous and asynchronous, and state machines (Mealy vs Moore)

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Von Neumann vs Harvard Architecture
topics.prompt: Von Neumann architecture vs Harvard architecture, stored program concept, instruction and data buses, bottleneck, and modified Harvard architecture in modern CPUs.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Instruction Cycle
topics.prompt: instruction cycle fetch decode execute, program counter, instruction register, MAR MDR, micro-operations, and how each phase maps to clock cycles.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Instruction Set Architecture
topics.prompt: ISA design, RISC vs CISC philosophy, x86 vs ARM vs RISC-V, instruction formats, addressing modes immediate direct indirect register indexed, and instruction encoding.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Pipelining
topics.prompt: 5-stage pipeline fetch decode execute memory writeback, pipeline speedup, pipeline throughput, pipeline latency, CPI with pipelining, and ideal vs real pipeline performance.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Pipeline Hazards
topics.prompt: data hazards RAW WAR WAW, control hazards branch penalty, structural hazards resource conflicts, forwarding/bypassing, pipeline stalls, and pipeline flushing.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Branch Prediction
topics.prompt: static vs dynamic branch prediction, 1-bit and 2-bit saturating counters, branch target buffer BTB, return address stack, tournament predictors, and branch misprediction penalty.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Out-of-Order Execution
topics.prompt: out-of-order execution, Tomasulo's algorithm, reservation stations, common data bus, register renaming, reorder buffer ROB, and how it achieves ILP.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Superscalar and VLIW
topics.prompt: superscalar processors, multiple issue slots, instruction-level parallelism ILP, VLIW very long instruction word, comparison with superscalar, and Itanium EPIC architecture.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Speculative Execution
topics.prompt: speculative execution, how CPU speculatively executes branch paths, Spectre and Meltdown vulnerabilities, transient execution attacks, and mitigation strategies.

topics.name: Memory Systems: SIMD and SIMT
topics.prompt: SIMD single instruction multiple data, SSE AVX AVX-512 NEON instructions, auto-vectorization, SIMT in GPUs, warp execution, and data-level parallelism.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: SRAM vs DRAM
topics.prompt: SRAM 6-transistor cell vs DRAM 1T1C cell, access times, density tradeoffs, refresh cycles in DRAM, and where each is used in memory hierarchy.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Cache Organization
topics.prompt: cache organization, direct-mapped, set-associative, fully-associative caches, tag index offset fields, cache line size tradeoffs, and how address bits are split.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Cache Replacement Policies
topics.prompt: cache replacement policies, LRU least recently used, FIFO, LFU least frequently used, random replacement, pseudo-LRU, and RRIP re-reference interval prediction.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Cache Write Policies
topics.prompt: cache write policies, write-through vs write-back, write-allocate vs no-write-allocate, write buffers, dirty bits, and how write policies affect performance and consistency.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Multi-Level Cache Hierarchy
topics.prompt: multi-level caches L1 L2 L3, inclusive vs exclusive vs NINE policies, cache access latencies, bandwidth at each level, and unified vs split L1 instruction data caches.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Cache Performance Analysis
topics.prompt: cache miss types compulsory capacity conflict, miss rate vs miss penalty, AMAT average memory access time, cache blocking for matrix multiply, and cache-oblivious algorithms.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Prefetching
topics.prompt: hardware prefetching, stride prefetcher, stream prefetcher, software prefetch instructions, prefetch distance, and when prefetching hurts performance cache pollution.

topics.name: Memory Systems: TLB and Virtual Memory
topics.prompt: TLB translation lookaside buffer structure, fully-associative TLB, TLB miss handling hardware vs software, TLB reach, and how TLB shootdown works in multiprocessor systems.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Page Tables
topics.prompt: page tables, single-level vs multi-level page tables, page table entry format, valid dirty reference bits, inverted page tables, and page table walks.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Huge Pages
topics.prompt: huge pages 2MB and 1GB, TLB coverage improvement, transparent huge pages in Linux, hugetlbfs, and tradeoffs of using huge pages for different workloads.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: MESI Cache Coherence Protocol
topics.prompt: MESI protocol states Modified Exclusive Shared Invalid, state transitions, bus snooping, BusRd BusRdX Flush transactions, and how MESI maintains coherence across cores.

topics.name: Memory Systems: MOESI and Directory-Based Coherence
topics.prompt: MOESI protocol Owned state addition, directory-based coherence for scalability beyond snooping, full-map vs limited directory, and coherence protocol comparison.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Memory Consistency Models
topics.prompt: memory consistency models, sequential consistency SC, total store order TSO, relaxed consistency, memory barriers fences, and how x86 TSO differs from ARM relaxed model.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Store and Load Buffers
topics.prompt: store buffers and load buffers in CPU, store-to-load forwarding, memory ordering implications, store buffer draining, and how they relate to memory consistency models.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: NUMA Architecture
topics.prompt: NUMA non-uniform memory access topology, local vs remote memory latency, NUMA nodes and interconnects, NUMA-aware programming, numactl, and NUMA balancing in Linux kernel.

topics.name: Memory Systems: CXL Protocol
topics.prompt: Compute Express Link CXL 1.1 2.0 3.0, CXL.io CXL.cache CXL.mem sub-protocols, memory pooling, disaggregated memory, and CXL device types (Type 1, 2, 3).

topics.name: Computer Architecture: HBM and GDDR Memory
topics.prompt: HBM2e HBM3 HBM3e high bandwidth memory, 3D stacking, through-silicon vias TSVs, GDDR6 GDDR6X, memory bandwidth comparison, and use cases in GPUs and AI accelerators.

topics.name: Memory Systems: DMA and I/O Architecture
topics.prompt: direct memory access DMA, DMA controller, scatter-gather DMA, MMIO vs PMIO, I/O bus architecture, and how DMA reduces CPU overhead for data transfers.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: PCIe Architecture
topics.prompt: PCIe peripheral component interconnect express, lanes and link widths, root complex switches endpoints, PCIe generations speed comparison, TLP transaction layer packets, and SR-IOV.

topics.name: Memory Systems: NVMe and SSD Internals
topics.prompt: NVMe protocol, submission and completion queues, NAND flash internals SLC MLC TLC QLC, wear leveling, garbage collection, TRIM command, and write amplification factor.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: GPU Architecture
topics.prompt: GPU architecture, streaming multiprocessors SM, CUDA cores, warp scheduling, shared memory vs global memory vs registers, memory coalescing, occupancy, and tensor cores.

topics.name: Memory Systems: OSI Model 7 Layers
topics.prompt: OSI model all 7 layers in detail, physical data-link network transport session presentation application, protocols at each layer, and how data gets encapsulated as it moves down.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: TCP/IP Model
topics.prompt: TCP/IP model 4 layers, comparison with OSI, link internet transport application layers, key protocols at each layer, and why TCP/IP won over OSI in practice.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Ethernet and Data Link
topics.prompt: Ethernet frame format, MAC addresses, ARP address resolution protocol, Ethernet switching, MAC address table, collision domains vs broadcast domains, and full duplex.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: IP Addressing and Subnetting
topics.prompt: IPv4 addressing, subnet masks, CIDR notation, VLSM, private IP ranges, network address translation NAT, IPv6 addressing, and transition mechanisms 6to4 dual-stack.

topics.name: Memory Systems: ICMP and Ping
topics.prompt: ICMP internet control message protocol, echo request reply, destination unreachable, time exceeded, traceroute mechanism, and path MTU discovery.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: DNS
topics.prompt: DNS domain name system, recursive vs iterative queries, DNS caching TTL, DNS record types A AAAA CNAME MX NS SOA TXT, DNS hierarchy root TLD authoritative, and DNSSEC.

topics.name: Memory Systems: DHCP
topics.prompt: DHCP dynamic host configuration protocol, DORA process discover offer request acknowledge, lease time, DHCP relay agent, and static vs dynamic allocation.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: TCP Deep Dive
topics.prompt: TCP in detail, 3-way handshake SYN SYN-ACK ACK, 4-way teardown, sequence and acknowledgment numbers, sliding window, flow control, and TCP state machine.

topics.name: Memory Systems: TCP Congestion Control
topics.prompt: TCP congestion control, slow start, congestion avoidance AIMD, fast retransmit, fast recovery, congestion window cwnd, ssthresh, and how TCP detects congestion.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: TCP Variants
topics.prompt: TCP Reno, TCP NewReno, TCP CUBIC default in Linux, TCP BBR bandwidth-based congestion control, comparison of loss-based vs delay-based, and which performs better on modern networks.

topics.name: Memory Systems: TCP Advanced Features
topics.prompt: Nagle's algorithm, delayed ACK, TCP keep-alive, TCP timestamps, selective acknowledgments SACK, window scaling, and TCP fast open TFO.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: UDP and QUIC
topics.prompt: UDP user datagram protocol, connectionless unreliable, when to use UDP vs TCP, QUIC protocol over UDP, multiplexed streams, 0-RTT connection, and head-of-line blocking elimination.

topics.name: Memory Systems: HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2
topics.prompt: HTTP/1.1 persistent connections pipelining, head-of-line blocking, HTTP/2 binary framing, multiplexing, server push, header compression HPACK, and stream prioritization.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: HTTP/3
topics.prompt: HTTP/3 over QUIC, why HTTP/3 moved to UDP, connection migration, improved head-of-line blocking, QPACK header compression, and deployment considerations.

topics.name: Memory Systems: TLS 1.3
topics.prompt: TLS 1.3 handshake, 1-RTT and 0-RTT modes, cipher suites, Diffie-Hellman key exchange, certificate chains, forward secrecy, and comparison with TLS 1.2.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: WebSocket and gRPC
topics.prompt: WebSocket protocol, upgrade handshake, full-duplex communication, gRPC over HTTP/2, protocol buffers, unary vs streaming RPCs, and REST vs GraphQL vs gRPC comparison.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Routing Protocols
topics.prompt: routing fundamentals, static vs dynamic routing, RIP distance vector, OSPF link-state, BGP path vector, EIGRP, route summarization, and administrative distance.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: BGP Deep Dive
topics.prompt: BGP border gateway protocol, AS autonomous systems, eBGP vs iBGP, BGP path attributes, route selection algorithm, BGP communities, and BGP hijacking prevention RPKI.

topics.name: Memory Systems: VLANs and Spanning Tree
topics.prompt: VLANs virtual LANs, 802.1Q tagging, trunk ports vs access ports, inter-VLAN routing, STP spanning tree protocol, RSTP rapid STP, and loop prevention.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: SDN and Network Virtualization
topics.prompt: software defined networking SDN, OpenFlow protocol, control plane vs data plane separation, NFV network function virtualization, virtual switches, and overlay networks VXLAN.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Network Security Fundamentals
topics.prompt: firewalls stateful vs stateless, IDS IPS intrusion detection prevention, VPN IPSec tunnel mode transport mode, WireGuard, and network segmentation principles.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: DDoS and Attack Mitigation
topics.prompt: DDoS distributed denial of service attacks, SYN flood, amplification attacks, rate limiting, anycast, scrubbing centers, and defense-in-depth strategies.

topics.name: Memory Systems: CAP Theorem
topics.prompt: CAP theorem consistency availability partition tolerance, why you can only pick two, PACELC extension, and how real distributed systems like DynamoDB Cassandra Spanner choose.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Paxos Consensus
topics.prompt: Paxos consensus protocol, proposer acceptor learner roles, single-decree Paxos, Multi-Paxos, why Paxos is hard to implement, and comparison with Raft.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Raft Consensus
topics.prompt: Raft consensus algorithm, leader election, log replication, safety, membership changes, comparison with Paxos, and real implementations like etcd.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: PBFT and BFT Consensus
topics.prompt: PBFT practical Byzantine fault tolerance, 3f+1 replicas needed, pre-prepare prepare commit phases, view changes, and Tendermint BFT consensus.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Consistent Hashing
topics.prompt: consistent hashing, virtual nodes, hash ring, adding removing nodes with minimal redistribution, applications in distributed caches and databases, and Rendezvous hashing.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Vector Clocks and Lamport Timestamps
topics.prompt: Lamport timestamps, happened-before relation, vector clocks for causality tracking, version vectors, conflict detection in distributed systems, and comparison of clock types.

topics.name: Memory Systems: CRDTs
topics.prompt: CRDTs conflict-free replicated data types, state-based vs operation-based, G-Counter, PN-Counter, G-Set, OR-Set, LWW-Register, and applications in collaborative editing.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: Two-Phase and Three-Phase Commit
topics.prompt: two-phase commit 2PC protocol, coordinator participant roles, blocking problem, three-phase commit 3PC, timeout handling, and saga pattern as an alternative.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Gossip Protocol
topics.prompt: gossip protocol epidemic broadcast, push pull push-pull variants, convergence time, membership protocol SWIM, and applications in failure detection and data dissemination.

topics.name: Computer Architecture: RDMA and InfiniBand
topics.prompt: RDMA remote direct memory access, InfiniBand network fabric, RoCEv2 RDMA over converged Ethernet, kernel bypass, zero-copy networking, and use in HPC and AI clusters.

topics.name: Memory Systems: Load Balancing
topics.prompt: load balancing algorithms, round robin, weighted round robin, least connections, IP hash, consistent hashing, L4 vs L7 load balancing, and health checks.

topics.name: Cache Performance: Cache Blocking and Matrix Multiplication Optimization
topics.prompt: explain cache blocking (tiling) to optimize matrix multiplication, spatial vs temporal locality, and sizing blocks to fit L1/L2 caches

topics.name: Cache Performance: Stride Access Patterns and Spatial Locality
topics.prompt: explain stride-1 vs non-unit stride memory access patterns, how cache lines prefetch sequential blocks, and loop interchange to fix stride

topics.name: Cache Performance: Cache Pollution and Conflict Misses
topics.prompt: explain conflict misses in direct-mapped and set-associative caches, cache way alignment, and avoiding cache pollution with non-temporal prefetch

topics.name: Instruction Execution: Pipeline Hazards and Branch Target Buffers
topics.prompt: explain structural, data, and control pipeline hazards, and how branch target buffers (BTB) minimize branch penalties

topics.name: Instruction Execution: Out-of-Order Execution and Register Renaming
topics.prompt: explain Tomasulo's algorithm for out-of-order execution, reservation stations, and register renaming to resolve WAR/WAW hazards

topics.name: Instruction Execution: Speculative Execution and Cache Side Channels
topics.prompt: explain speculative execution, branch prediction direction, and how CPU speculation transient states create cache timing side channels

topics.name: Memory Interface: HBM3e Memory Channels and Cache Hierarchy Coherence
topics.prompt: explain HBM3e high-bandwidth memory channel layout, cache coherence protocols (MESI/MOESI), and directory-based coherence for multi-socket systems

topics.name: Memory Interface: NUMA Architecture and Memory Access Latency
topics.prompt: explain Non-Uniform Memory Access (NUMA) node affinity, local vs remote memory latency, and page migration strategies in OS

topics.name: Network Performance: TCP Window Scaling and Buffer Sizing
topics.prompt: explain TCP sliding window flow control, window scaling option for high-delay networks, and tuning socket send/receive buffer sizes

topics.name: Network Performance: TCP Congestion Control Algorithms (BBR vs Cubic)
topics.prompt: compare loss-based congestion control (Cubic) with delay/bandwidth-based control (BBR), explaining throughput and queue buildup trade-offs

topics.name: In-Memory Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication using Crossbar Arrays for Graph Analytics
topics.prompt: Let's design a crossbar-based PIM accelerator for sparse matrix-vector multiplication tailored to large-scale graph analytics workloads.

topics.name: PIM-Optimized Binarized Neural Network Inference on Resistive RAM for Edge Devices
topics.prompt: Let's explore how to implement binarized neural network inference directly within resistive RAM crossbars, focusing on weight quantization and activation mapping.

topics.name: In-Memory Hierarchical Clustering via Density Peak Algorithm on 3D Stacked Memory
topics.prompt: Let's formulate a density-peak clustering algorithm that operates entirely within 3D stacked memory, minimizing off-chip traffic.

topics.name: PIM-Enabled Real-Time Kalman Filtering for Sensor Fusion on Embedded SRAM Arrays
topics.prompt: Let's develop a Kalman filter that runs in-place on embedded SRAM arrays, optimizing for low latency sensor fusion.

topics.name: Mathematical Modeling of Bit-Flip Noise Impact on PIM-based Graph Coloring Algorithms
topics.prompt: Let's analyze how bit-flip noise in PIM memory affects the correctness and convergence of graph coloring algorithms executed in-memory.

topics.name: Resistive Crossbar-Based BFS for Massive Social Graphs
topics.prompt: Let's design a resistive crossbar memory that can perform breadth-first search on a 10-million-node social network with minimal off-chip traffic.

topics.name: Analog In-Memory Convolution for Real-Time Video Edge Detection
topics.prompt: Let's build an analog in-memory convolution engine using memristor MACs to accelerate Sobel filtering on 4K video streams.

topics.name: Hybrid Digital-Analog In-Memory Bayesian Inference for Autonomous Sensor Fusion
topics.prompt: Let's create a hybrid SRAM–memristor architecture that performs Bayesian updates on multi-sensor data streams in real time.

topics.name: Programmable In-Memory Sparse Matrix Multiplication for Finite Element Analysis
topics.prompt: Let's design a programmable in-memory accelerator that handles irregular sparse matrices with compression and dynamic reconfiguration for FEA.

topics.name: Stochastic Memristive In-Memory Optimization for Large-Scale Vehicle Routing
topics.prompt: Let's develop a stochastic memristive in-memory algorithm that solves vehicle routing problems with thousands of nodes and complex constraints.

topics.name: Processing-in-Memory for Graph Algorithms: Parallelizing BFS/DFS on Hybrid Memory Architectures
topics.prompt: I need to optimize Breadth-First Search (BFS) and Depth-First Search (DFS) for large-scale graphs (e.g., social networks with 100M+ nodes) by leveraging Processing-in-Memory (PIM) architectures like UPMEM or Samsung's PIM DIMMs. How would you mathematically model the data movement vs. computation trade-offs when storing adjacency lists in PIM cores vs. traditional DRAM? Provide a concrete implementation using a PIM SDK (e.g., UPMEM's SDK) where each PIM core processes subgraphs independently, and discuss how to handle graph partitioning to minimize inter-core communication overhead.

topics.name: In-Memory Matrix Factorization for Recommender Systems: Accelerating SGD with PIM
topics.prompt: How would you implement Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) for matrix factorization (e.g., for a Netflix-scale recommender system with a 10K x 100K user-item matrix) entirely within Processing-in-Memory (PIM) cores, avoiding traditional DRAM access for updates? Derive the computational complexity of updating latent factors in PIM vs. CPU/GPU, and provide a PIM-optimized algorithm that minimizes inter-core synchronization. Use a real-world dataset (e.g., MovieLens 20M) to benchmark latency and energy efficiency compared to state-of-the-art GPU implementations.

topics.name: PIM-Accelerated Spiking Neural Networks: Event-Driven Computation in Hybrid Memory
topics.prompt: Design a Processing-in-Memory (PIM) architecture to accelerate event-driven computation in Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), where synaptic updates and membrane potentials are computed in-memory using analog PIM (e.g., RRAM or PCM-based designs). How would you map neuron spikes to PIM cores to exploit temporal locality, and what mathematical formulation would you use to bound the error introduced by analog PIM computations (e.g., due to device variability)? Provide a simulation framework (e.g., using PyTorch or NEST) to evaluate the trade-offs between energy savings and classification accuracy for a benchmark like the MNIST-DVS dataset.

topics.name: Processing-in-Memory for Real-Time Video Processing: In-Sensor CNN Inference with PIM
topics.prompt: Propose an architecture where Processing-in-Memory (PIM) is used to perform real-time convolutional neural network (CNN) inference directly on the sensor (e.g., a PIM-enabled CMOS image sensor). How would you optimize memory access patterns for 2D convolutions (e.g., 3x3 kernels) by storing weights in PIM arrays and streaming pixel data from the sensor? Derive the bandwidth requirements for a 1080p video stream at 60 FPS and compare the energy efficiency of this approach against traditional von Neumann architectures. Implement a proof-of-concept using a PIM simulator (e.g., Ramulator with PIM extensions) and benchmark against a GPU-based baseline.

topics.name: Mathematical Formulations for PIM-Based Sorting and Hashing: Lower Bounds and Algorithms
topics.prompt: Derive the theoretical lower bounds for sorting and hash table operations (e.g., insert, lookup) when computed entirely within Processing-in-Memory (PIM) architectures, where PIM cores can only access local memory blocks. Provide two concrete algorithms: (1) a PIM-optimized radix sort that exploits bit-level parallelism in PIM, and (2) a cuckoo hashing variant that minimizes write amplification in PIM arrays. Benchmark these against GPU-accelerated versions (e.g., using CUDA Thrust) on a dataset of 100M 32-bit integers, and analyze the impact of PIM core failure rates on correctness.

topics.name: Design and Optimization of In-Memory Accumulator Networks for Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication
topics.prompt: Let's design an in-memory accumulator network that efficiently handles sparse matrix-vector multiplication for large-scale graph analytics, focusing on memory bandwidth and energy efficiency.

topics.name: Programmable Resistive Crossbar Arrays for 3D Convolutional Neural Network Inference
topics.prompt: Let's explore how to program 3D convolution kernels onto resistive crossbar arrays and analyze the trade-offs between precision and energy consumption for mobile AI devices.

topics.name: Fault-Tolerant Bit-Serial Arithmetic Units in Emerging Memory for Edge AI
topics.prompt: Let's design a bit-serial arithmetic unit that operates directly in emerging memory arrays while tolerating stuck-at faults and quantifying error resilience for edge inference workloads.

topics.name: Dynamic Voltage and Temperature Scaling in PIM-enabled DRAM for Real-time Video Encoding
topics.prompt: Let's formulate a DVS/T scaling policy that maximizes throughput for real-time video encoding on DRAM-based PIM, including a model of temperature-dependent leakage and write endurance.

topics.name: Co-Design of PIM-based Graph Traversal Engine with Hierarchical TLB for Large Graphs
topics.prompt: Let's co-design a PIM graph traversal engine that uses a hierarchical TLB to manage memory accesses for billion-node graphs, optimizing cache line prefetching and locality exploitation.

topics.name: In-Memory Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication on Resistive RAM Crossbars
topics.prompt: Let's design a resistive RAM crossbar-based in-memory implementation for sparse matrix-vector multiplication, focusing on data mapping, weight encoding, and latency optimization.

topics.name: Energy-Efficient In-Memory Convolution Engine Using Phase-Change Memory for CNNs
topics.prompt: Let's develop an energy-efficient in-memory convolution engine leveraging phase-change memory, detailing the weight storage, analog multiplication, and error mitigation techniques.

topics.name: Analog In-Memory Sorting Network for Real-Time Data Streams
topics.prompt: Let's implement an analog in-memory sorting network using memristor arrays to sort continuous data streams in real-time, optimizing for throughput and precision.

topics.name: Hybrid PCM-Resistive Memory Architecture for Real-Time Graph Analytics
topics.prompt: Let's architect a hybrid PCM-resistive memory system tailored for real-time graph analytics, specifying data layout, traversal acceleration, and consistency mechanisms.

topics.name: Stochastic In-Memory Matrix Multiplication for Solving Linear Systems
topics.prompt: Let's design a stochastic in-memory matrix multiplication scheme using probabilistic computing elements to solve large linear systems efficiently, focusing on accuracy bounds and convergence.

topics.name: Processing-in-Memory: Accelerated Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication via Row-Column Partitioning
topics.prompt: Let's design a PIM architecture that efficiently handles sparse matrix-vector multiplication using row-column partitioning, compression, and in-memory reduction techniques.

topics.name: Processing-in-Memory: In-Memory Graph Traversal for PageRank Using Hop-Count Encoding
topics.prompt: Let's develop an in-memory algorithm for PageRank that encodes hop counts and performs parallel updates across memory arrays, minimizing data movement.

topics.name: Processing-in-Memory: Neural Network Inference with Mixed-Precision Quantization on Resistive Crossbar Arrays
topics.prompt: Let's explore mixed-precision quantization for deep neural network inference on resistive crossbar PIM hardware, focusing on accuracy–energy trade-offs.

topics.name: Processing-in-Memory: Data-Parallel FFT Implementation on 3D Stacked DRAM with In-Place Cooley-Tukey
topics.prompt: Let's implement a data-parallel FFT on 3D stacked DRAM using in-place Cooley-Tukey algorithm and evaluate latency and bandwidth utilization.

topics.name: Processing-in-Memory: Real-Time Video Compression Using In-Memory DCT on Emerging MRAM
topics.prompt: Let's design a real-time video compression pipeline that performs DCT and motion estimation directly in MRAM arrays, optimizing for low-latency and power.
